title: Letters of John Huss, Written During His Exile and Imprisonment
coverage: Primary correspondence and editorial context covering Hus's reform campaign, exile, journey to Constance, imprisonment, trial, refusal to recant, and execution

title: History of the Zulu War
coverage: Independent contemporary account of Zulu state formation, social institutions, the 1879 war, Cetshwayo's defeat and capture, and the postwar settlement; retained as a clearly colonial viewpoint requiring later counter-evidence

title: The Balkan Wars: 1912-1913
coverage: Diplomatic and military account of the Balkan alliances, Bulgaria's campaign against the Ottoman Empire, inter-allied disputes, the Second Balkan War, territorial losses, and the postwar settlement

title: History of the Saracens
coverage: Independent historical account restricted to the crisis surrounding Uthman's death, Ali's accession, the First Fitna, arbitration, Ali's assassination, and the transition to Hasan and Muawiya

title: Through Russian Central Asia
coverage: Independent account restricted to Central Asian tribal history and the Russian conquest, including the Tekke, Geok Tepe, annexation, and immediate colonial aftermath
